name: Clockify
summary: Clockify is free for up to 5 users, and its paid plans run from $3.99 to $11.99 per seat a month on annual billing. Timesheet approval starts on Standard at $5.49. Screenshots, app tracking and GPS are optional features on Pro.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: The QuickBooks Online integration does not work with QuickBooks accounts that have payroll turned on.
Syncing hours to QuickBooks Payroll needs a separate add-on at $6.99 a month for the whole workspace.
Activity monitoring on Pro records visited websites and apps, keyboard and mouse activity and screenshots, and screenshot capture is optional.
Pro and Enterprise workspaces can store data in the USA, the EU (Germany), the UK or Australia.
The free plan limits reports to one month at a time, and CSV and Excel exports are on paid plans only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 users; PDF exports only

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually; $6.99 on monthly billing. Adds timesheet approval and invoicing

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually; $9.99 on monthly billing. Adds GPS, activity monitoring and data regions

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually; $14.99 on monthly billing. Adds single sign-on and SCIM

hiddenCosts: People who only clock in at a shared kiosk need limited seats, from $0.79 a month on Basic with annual billing.
The QuickBooks Payroll add-on costs $6.99 a month per workspace, and the Xero add-on costs $4.99 a month.
Every active or invited user on the Team page takes a paid seat.

contract.cancellation: Cancel any time in account settings. Payments are non-refundable, and a cancelled workspace drops to the free plan.
contract.dataExport: Reports as PDF on the free plan and as CSV or Excel on Basic and above, plus an API on every plan.
